title: 'Aachi Aachi': First Song From Mani Ratnam's Inji Vellam Is Out
excerpt: AR Rahman's first single for the Vijay Sethupathi–Sai Pallavi Tamil romance introduces Pallavi's pregnant character in a hand-drawn lyric video, two months before the January 29, 2027 release.
body:
• 'Aachi Aachi', the first single from Mani Ratnam's Tamil film Inji Vellam, was released on Wednesday, November 25, with music by AR Rahman — his 19th collaboration with the director.
  • The song is sung by Vaishali Samant and Sharanya Srinivas, with Tamil lyrics by Ilango Krishnan and Malayalam lyrics by Vinayak Sasikumar.
  • The lyric video gives a first look at Sai Pallavi's character — a cropped-hair, pregnant woman — opposite Vijay Sethupathi, in their first film together.
  • Inji Vellam opens in theatres worldwide on Friday, January 29, 2027.

The first song from Mani Ratnam's next film is out. 'Aachi Aachi', the first single from the Tamil-language romantic drama Inji Vellam, was unveiled by the makers on Wednesday, November 25, and the response has centred on two things: AR Rahman's music and Sai Pallavi's dance. Rahman has composed the film's music in what Cinema Express counts as his 19th collaboration with Mani Ratnam.

The track is sung by Vaishali Samant and Sharanya Srinivas and blends Tamil and Malayalam lyrics, penned by Ilango Krishnan and Vinayak Sasikumar respectively. Madras Talkies announced the release on its social media timelines, writing, "#AachiAachi is Out Now. Puyal fans assemble," according to IANS.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=hsrO7UK6b3E

A first look at Sai Pallavi's character

The lyric video shows glimpses from the film and offers viewers a first look at Sai Pallavi's character. She sports a boy cut in the number, and the character is pregnant — the song is picturised on her and shows women who are expecting dancing to the track. Cinema Express describes the upbeat number as recounting the happy journey of a woman's love. Promotional material for the film has introduced the lead pair as parents to twin girls, and the single backs up pregnancy as a key plot point.

The film

Inji Vellam (the title pairs inji, ginger, with vellam, jaggery — a pairing the two leads playfully argued over in the title-announcement clip in September) is written and directed by Mani Ratnam, who co-wrote the script with Siva Ananth. It stars Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, in their first pairing on screen, with Chaithra J Achar also in the cast. The film reunites Sethupathi with Ratnam after Chekka Chivantha Vaanam (2018), and it is Pallavi's first project with the director.

The film is produced by Mani Ratnam and Siva Ananth under the Madras Talkies banner, with Subaskaran producing under Lyca Productions; India Talkies is also a production partner. The crew includes cinematographer Avik Mukhopadhyay, editor Sreekar Prasad, art director Sharmishta Roy, costume designer Eka Lakhani, action choreographer Dhilip Subbarayan and dance choreographer Brinda Gopal.

The project was officially announced in March 2026 under the tentative title Production No. 23, Madras Talkies' 23rd venture, and the title Inji Vellam was revealed the following September. Principal photography ran from July to October 2026, including locations in Kolkata. The film has music by Rahman, cinematography by Avik Mukhopadhyay and editing by A. Sreekar Prasad.

How to watch

Inji Vellam is scheduled to open in theatres worldwide on Friday, January 29, 2027. No streaming date has been announced. For diaspora audiences, the worldwide theatrical release means the film should play in US theatres on the same date; 'Aachi Aachi' is available now on the film's official audio release, and the lyric video is embedded above.
